the problem of energy efficient routing for optimal detection of MRFs in wireless sensor networks.

the proposed DFMRF scheme achieves the optimal performance for a large class of MRFs.
the optimal routing for MRFs is to transmit the local log-likelihood ratios to the fusion center, and the optimal routing for Gaussian fields is to transmit the raw data.
